programs.title: Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year
programs.desc: Harpreet Singh Bedi, a commerce graduate, becomes a salesman. After being ridiculed by his colleagues and his employer, he plans to operate a parallel company without their knowledge.

programs.title: Baabul
programs.desc: After his son's death, Balraj attempts to convince his daughter-in-law Malvika to marry Rajat, her childhood friend. However, his endeavours are disregarded by his wife and elder brother.

programs.title: Bobby Aur Rishi Ki Love Story
programs.desc: Bobby's diverted flight leads to meeting Rishi at Heathrow, sparking a connection during a day in Cambridge. Two years later, they are married but face relationship issues.

programs.title: Panga
programs.desc: Jaya, a former Kabaddi world champion, is pushed into making a comeback into the sport by her family. However, she first has to battle her internal conflicts and the expectations society has of her.

programs.title: Khuda Haafiz
programs.desc: When a financial crisis leaves Sameer and Nargis jobless, they resort to taking up a job in the Middle East. But when Nargis goes missing on arrival, Sameer sets out on a bloody quest to find her.

programs.title: Akelli
programs.desc: An Indian woman travels to Mosul, Iraq to work as a supervisor in a garments factory. However, when a terrorist organisation attacks the city, she becomes trapped in a war-zone.

programs.title: Madras Cafe
programs.desc: Vikram, an Indian intelligence agent who visits Sri Lanka on a secret mission, finds himself embroiled in a civil war and a conspiracy to kill the former prime minister of India.

programs.title: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
programs.desc: A young man tries to arrange a marriage for his brother, but finds himself falling in love with the chosen fiancée.

programs.title: Pink
programs.desc: After being molested, Minal, along with her friends, tries to file an FIR against a politician's nephew. When the subsequent case gets rigged, Deepak, a retired lawyer, helps them to fight the case.

programs.title: Ishqiya
programs.desc: Khalujan and Babban, two rogues, fall in love with Krishna, their friend's widow. However, Krishna manipulates them into carrying out her bidding for her selfish gain.

programs.title: Sanju
programs.desc: Bollywood actor Sanjay Sanju Dutt slogs through the quagmire of personal turmoil, substance abuse, and legal battles to find his way to dizzying heights of success.

programs.title: Fatso!
programs.desc: Killed by accident due to a clerical error in heaven, Navin gets a second chance at life on Earth. However, since his body is unavailable, he must make a go of things in the body of his portly friend.
